dog.description_text: Meet Popeye — New Arrival! Popeye just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQAxiRM-tuIbSbDnvvJGe8uOAV65mdm0mWM3wJ71gAr_o3U?e=8WcdFc Popeye is a 3 year old grey male. He is neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. His foster says "he’s the king of the house lol he’s very observant. He’s very energetic and runs around at home but he’s also very sweet and loves to be pet when he’s relaxed. He wants and likes getting pet before he eats his food and I just love that.". He is an affectionate and playful guy. He loves looking at himself in the mirror which is very adorable !!! Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
